← Kohler dashboards

Asset Inventory

POS materials, signage, glassware, displays and equipment held upstairs at Hawthorne. What we have, what is spoken for, what came in, what went out, and where it was placed.

Current inventory

One row per item. On hand is a count of the physical units in the Assets export; Open is requests waiting on a unit; Available is on hand minus open. Tap any row for detail.

Open requests

Requests with no unit pulled yet. A request with a unit allocated has already left the stockroom and is counted under Sent out instead. There is no cancelled state in the export, so anything ageing past days is flagged rather than assumed dead.

Recently received

Units added to the stockroom, by the date their record was created. This only shows units still on hand — anything received and already sent back out has left the export and cannot appear here. Treat it as "what arrived and is still upstairs", not a full receiving log.

Recently sent out

Fulfilled requests — each one a specific unit that was allocated and is gone from stock. Confirmed by the join: none of these units appear in the on-hand export. The request export carries no customer, so the destination is in Placed by customer instead.

Placed assets by customer

Where placed assets went. Units is the lifetime total at that account and 2026 is this year's share of it — the two placement exports are the same placements over different windows, joined on customer + item, never added together.

Data issues

Records worth a look. Everything listed here is held out of the totals above unless the note says it was counted, so the headline numbers stay clean.
